newsitem.title: USA: IPALCO seeks to purchase preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPALCO seeks to purchase preferred shrs.

text.p: IPALCO Enterprises Inc said Friday it plans a cash purchase of the outstanding shares of the cumulative preferred stock of Indianapolis Power & Light Co, a direct subsidiary of IPALCO.

The offer is conditioned upon, among other things, IPALCO's shareholders' approval of an amendment to the company's amended articles of incorporation that would remove a provision of the articles limiting the company's ability to issue unsecured debt, including short-term debt.
Also, preferred shareholders who wish to tender their shares pursuant to the offer must vote in favor of the amendment, the company said.
The company Friday filed preliminary documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission describing the contemplated offer.
IPALCO shares were down 10/16 at 32-3/16 Friday.
